blindSummary:
In October-November 2024 the transitional legislature adopted a new penal code criminalising homosexuality for the first time — the justice minister declared that anyone “engaging in, promoting or defending” same-sex relations would be prosecuted; the vague drafting suggests broad application, and prior public-indecency provisions were already being used against gender-nonconforming people. Military rule means there is no independent judiciary, no civil-society space, and active conflict in much of the country.

For a visitor: a brand-new criminalisation statute under a military government with no recourse, plus conflict conditions.
blindOutOfScope: The 2024 penal code's application to trans expression is via the indecency provisions; the drafting vagueness is noted by an international legal-aid trust.
